featured_reviews.review_text:

The shop uses proper equipment and products to work on the bikes, for example a proper brake bleeding system is used, to make sure there isn't any brake oil being spilled on the frame or any other painted surfaces. While they work on the bike, if any other issue is noticed and the part has to be replaced, they will first call up ask if you want go ahead with additional repairs. The owners of the shop treat the customers with respect and answer any doubts you have with the bike or any other queries related to maintenance or biking.

Cheers,
Dhruv Shetty.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Good Store with a huge stock, u get variety of choice and wide price range to choose from.
One STAR removed as the staff there who assemble cycle, they just try to give u cycle without doing proper wheel alignment by telling that its normal for brake-pad to touch wheel rim if its new. I forced them to align it and made sure its proper before i pay for new cycle.

When u buy cycle just make sure that the wheel alignment is proper. To check "Lift cycle and rotate the wheel slowly" The brake-pad shouldn't touch rim from any side and wheel shouldn't stop abruptly. If it does then, it has to be aligned till perfection. After they claim that its done, then we shud again check, apply brake and release and again rotate the wheel.
I EXPECTED them to do this this step as their own responsibility and not to take it carelessly as its an imp aspect.
--Enjoy cycling!

featured_reviews.name: Omkar Salagare
featured_reviews.review_text:
Being a first time buyer and being new to this. I recently purchased a Studds helmet from this store, and at the time of purchase, the owner made very strong claims like “whatever happens, just come to me, I’ll get it repaired.”

Unfortunately, when I faced an issue, that assurance turned out to be completely misleading.

To be fair, I understand the damage happened due to heat exposure from my bike’s silencer, so it may not fall under standard warranty. However, the problem here is not just the product—it’s the false commitment made at the time of sale.

Customers rely on the words of the seller while making a purchase. Giving unrealistic promises just to close a sale is highly unprofessional and breaks trust.

I would strongly advise future buyers to rely only on official warranty terms and not verbal assurances from the store.

Very disappointing experience.

featured_reviews.name: Chandresh Kori
featured_reviews.review_text: One of the best shops for helmets and riding gear! They have a wide variety of branded helmets, jackets, gloves, and accessories. The staff is knowledgeable and explains safety features clearly before purchase. The fitting guidance was perfect and the pricing is genuine. Great place for riders who care about safety and style!

featured_reviews.name: Sunil Srisunder
featured_reviews.review_text:
I would like to sincerely appreciate Raj and Shyam for their outstanding professionalism and customer service. I made a simple call from Europe to book a helmet for my family, and they responded with kindness and efficiency.

What truly impressed me was their willingness to dispatch the helmet for delivery even before the payment reached their accounts. This gesture reflects not only their trust but also their commitment to customer satisfaction.

Raj and Shyam demonstrated remarkable speed, courtesy, and business acumen. Their gentle approach and quick service show that they truly understand both business and customer care. It is rare to find such dedication, and I am grateful for their support.

Thank you, Raj and Shyam, for setting such a high standard in service and professionalism.
